title: Digital Presence reimagine
description: End-to-end development of Tasq Consulting's digital presence — strategy, UX, and development. Resulted in a 340% increase in qualified leads within 90 days of launch.

title: Fintech Web App
description: Superlabs is a fintech startup that needed a web presence capable of building trust with both individual users and enterprise clients. title: Digital Presence reimagine
description: A manufacturer with no digital presence, Foam Crafts India needed a professional website to reach wholesale buyers and interior designers online. We designed a product-showcase site with a clean catalog layout, optimised imagery, and local SEO — opening a new inbound channel that had previously been entirely reliant on offline referrals.

title: Job Portal Website
description: Hirescript is a hiring platform connecting companies with tech talent. We designed and built their full job portal — candidate profiles, employer dashboards, and a search-and-filter engine — with an emphasis on speed and usability on mobile. The launch-ready product went from zero to functional MVP in under 8 weeks.

title: Digital Presence reimagine
description: An independent bookstore looking to expand beyond foot traffic needed an e-commerce experience that reflected their personality and made discovery a pleasure. We built a browseable, fast-loading storefront with curated collections, a smart search, and a seamless checkout — giving the client a fully owned sales channel outside of marketplace platforms.
